description: Connect a GDEX trading account without putting any secret in the conversation. Signs in from a control-wallet key file on this machine (keyFile), or creates a new local wallet (create: true), or refreshes an existing accountRef. Returns an accountRef plus public addresses; pass accountRef to any trading tool instead of sessionPrivateKey/privateKey. Never ask the user to paste a private key or seed phrase.

accountRef.description: Refresh the session of an already connected account

create.description: Create and store a new local control wallet (it starts unfunded)

inviteCode.description: Only with create: true, and only when the user explicitly chose to use someone's GDEX invite. Counts only for a brand-new account.

keyFile.description: Path to a local JSON key file ({ privateKey } or { control: { privateKey } })

name: gdex_connect
